cases.prompt: Hola, soy nuevo aquí. ¿Cómo empiezo?
cases.setup: Fresh Chat.

expected.detail: Chat reply in Spanish with a starting point.

cases.prompt: In the lab notes I highlighted, why did the liquid change color? Just explain it in words.
cases.setup: Authorized highlighted lab notes.

expected.detail: Source-grounded Chat reply.

cases.prompt: Can Motion add a voice-over?
cases.setup: Use the current Motion capability settings.

expected.detail: Chat reply about the tool’s actual audio capability.

cases.prompt: Can you make an animated video for softmax?
cases.setup: Motion, Whiteboard and Animation are ready.

expected.detail: One playable video review intent. Motion fits a visual sequence and Whiteboard fits a narrated drawing treatment. The selected output must be a video.

cases.prompt: Make a 20-second silent clip showing why the Moon has phases. Label the Sun, Earth, and Moon.
cases.setup: Motion supports the requested settings.

expected.detail: `/motion` review intent with a 20-second visual plan and audio off.

cases.prompt: I keep mixing up denominators. Make a video where a voice explains each step as you write out the fractions.
cases.setup: Whiteboard narration is ready.

expected.detail: `/whiteboard` (`whiteboard-video`) review intent for a narrated worked example.

cases.prompt: Let me turn a crank in a 3D scene and watch the piston move.
cases.setup: Animation supports the controls.

expected.detail: `/animation` review intent for a controllable 3D scene.

cases.prompt: Make a little explainer where I slide the resistance up and down and see the current change. Keep the voltage fixed.
cases.setup: Interactive Explain supports the requested slider and readout.

expected.detail: Interactive `/explain` review intent with a fixed voltage and live current readout.

cases.prompt: Turn this onboarding checklist into a flowchart. Include what happens when the ID check fails.
cases.setup: The source contains both branches.

expected.detail: `/diagram` handoff using the source steps and decision branches.

cases.prompt: Plot my 5K times. Jan 5 was 29:10, Jan 12 was 28:54, and Jan 19 was 28:07.
cases.setup: Dates and times are in the request.

expected.detail: `/graph` handoff with dates and elapsed times.

cases.prompt: Make a CAD model of a 60 × 30 × 3 mm plate with a 5 mm through-hole in the center.
cases.setup: CAD accepts the geometry and units.

expected.detail: `/cad` review intent with the specified dimensions and hole.

cases.prompt: Make a watercolor illustration of a fox curled up in the snow.
cases.setup: Image generation is qualified.

expected.detail: `/image` (`generate-image`) review intent.

cases.prompt: Can you find a real photo of a fox curled up in the snow?
cases.setup: Photo search is qualified.

expected.detail: `/photos` (`image`) search handoff.

cases.prompt: Find me a video where someone ties a bowline slowly enough to follow.
cases.setup: Video search is qualified.

expected.detail: `/youtube` search handoff for an existing instructional video.

cases.prompt: Quiz me on the causes of the French Revolution from this page. Give me one multiple-choice question.
cases.setup: The page is authorized and the quiz flow is qualified.

expected.detail: `/quiz` handoff for one source-grounded multiple-choice question.

cases.prompt: /code Write a Python function that converts a list of Celsius readings to Fahrenheit.
cases.setup: Typed command.

expected.detail: Named `/code` handler with the requested function as input.

cases.prompt: Could you animate this?
cases.setup: The selected diagram suits either a video or a live scene and both are ready.

expected.detail: Ask whether the learner wants a video to watch or a scene to control.

cases.prompt: Graph my weekly run times.
cases.setup: No dates or run times supplied.

expected.detail: Ask for the dates and times, then continue the same request when they arrive.

cases.prompt: Make a short video explaining why bread rises.
cases.setup: Motion is unavailable and Whiteboard is ready.

expected.detail: Offer a qualified Whiteboard review that still delivers a playable video.

cases.prompt: Make a narrated drawing that shows how a P-trap holds water.
cases.setup: Whiteboard is unavailable and Motion has audio off.

expected.detail: Give useful help in Chat and ask whether a silent walkthrough is acceptable if one is ready. Keep narration required until the learner chooses.
